analysis.title: Short Consumer Staples (GSXUSTAP)
key_insights: GS FICC & Equities (Louis Miller) likes shorting the Diversified Staples Basket (GSXUSTAP) because its earnings yield and dividend yield look unattractive relative to fixed income.
The valuation premium of S&P Staples to SPX is at its highest level in 10+ years. The GSXUSTAP dividend yield of 2.84% is 2.05pp below its 10-year average, the 1st percentile of the last 10 years.

GSXUSTAP has outperformed SPX by nearly 20% in the last month and is now up 1% more than SPX over the last year. Staples have historically lagged in the 3 months after similar events, with the exception of late 2021/early 2022.
Staples just had their best month in 5+ years, which brings YTD performance to the second best in 10 years.
Earnings have lagged the latest price action, and Earnings Revision Breadth is rolling over at the same time. The P/E of GSXUSTAP is in the 90th percentile over the last year.
The desk prefers to express the view delta one (short the basket on swap) because with rates where they are the short earns carry on swap, while puts look rich and put skew is near the lows.
